Mamhie,

Happy 58th Monthsary mamhie❤️

Even though distance keeps us apart for now, please know that my love for you never gets smaller. I may not be beside you to hug you, kiss you, or hold your hand, but you are always close to my heart. I miss you more than words can explain, and I look forward to the day when distance will no longer be part of our love story.

No matter how far we are from each other, my heart will always find its way to you. I will keep choosing you, loving you, and praying for the day we no longer have to say goodbye.

Happy 58th months of love, and still you are my favorite person. I love you always, Mamhie. ❤️

- Hon💓..
